verdict.rationale: The California EDD is a state government agency whose e-Services handle payroll tax accounts, filings, and payments under its own legal jurisdiction. A user-selectable storage region is not a meaningful axis for this kind of public-agency service. Nothing in the evidence suggests the agency offers any such choice, so the story's axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
